name: Rust Monster
summary: A monstrosity that corrodes and destroys metal armor and weapons with its antennae.

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.text: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.text: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, the creature with the object. *Failure:* The object takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the *{ref:spell/mending}* spell on the armor or weapon.

actions.name: Destroy Metal
actions.text: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn't being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.

reactions.name: Reflexive Antennae
reactions.text: *Trigger:* An attack roll hits the rust monster. *Response:* The rust monster uses Antennae.
